svg.title: ArtViSiON — ADVERTiSiNG: hoardings, neon, outdoor media and window displays
svg.desc: Flat vector scene in three zones: the hoarding on its scaffold with the campaign artwork and a light sweep, the neon sign on its dark fascia, and the store with its glazed window display, mannequin, plinths and A-board. Animated. Editable layers: background, artwork, logo.
